name: Megasuki! ~Kanojo to Boku no Megane Jijou~ Toono Shiori Hen
original_name: メガスキ！ 〜彼女と僕の眼鏡事情〜 遠野志桜里編
source:
The main character, Makoto Kougami, has just transferred to a new school. He has a crush on his beautiful math teacher, Shiori Toono. 

She is a serious and inflexible girl who is not well received by the male students.  However, Makoto is crazy about her. 

One day, he sees her taking care of a cat.  The two quickly become closer through their common topic of conversation about the cat she keeps at home. 

Can Makoto be able to break down her firm guard?

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/glasses/megasuki2/shiori.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
主角小神诚刚刚转学到新学校。他迷恋上美丽的数学老师远野诗织。

她是一个严肃而刻板的女孩，不太受男学生欢迎。然而，真琴却为她着迷。

有一天，他看到她正在照顾一只猫。两人通过关于她家里养的猫的共同话题很快变得更加亲密。

真琴能否打破她的戒备呢？

[来自[url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/glasses/megasuki2/shiori.html]官方网站[/url]]
